name: QuickGO Gene Ontology API
summary: Gene Ontology terms, evidence codes and GO annotations for gene products, with search and filtering.
description: QuickGO is the EBI browser for the Gene Ontology and GOA annotations; its REST API serves ontology terms (GO and ECO), term search and hierarchy, annotation search and downloads, and gene product lookups. A term search for apoptosis returned 352 hits on 2026-11-11.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented in the pages fetched; fair use.

example.response_excerpt: {"numberOfHits":352,"results":[{"id":"GO:0097194","isObsolete":false,"name":"execution phase of apoptosis","definition":{"text":"A stage of the apoptotic process that starts with ..."},"aspect":"biological_process"},...],"pageInfo":{...}}

license.name: Gene Ontology data is CC BY 4.0 (not re-confirmed on this host); EBI terms of use apply

agent_notes: GO ids use the form GO:0006915. Annotation queries are large: always filter by taxonId or geneProductId and page with limit/page. Download bulk annotations with the /annotation/downloadSearch endpoint (not tested).
caveats: The api-docs page at /QuickGO/services/api-docs is a UI shell, not a spec; no OpenAPI URL was confirmed.
License text was not confirmed on the EBI pages fetched today; GO itself is CC BY 4.0 by project policy (not re-confirmed).
Annotation search without filters is very large.
